name: Hongwu Emperor
contribution: The founding emperor of the Ming dynasty of China, reigning from 1368 to 1398.

checks.lead: The Hongwu Emperor (21 October 1328 – 24 June 1398), personal name Zhu Yuanzhang, was the founding emperor of the Ming dynasty of China, reigning from 1368 to 1398.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
